exposure: active management of oligohydramnios (i.e. induction of labor)
Women with isolated oligohydramnios managed actively
Women with normal amniotic fluid and spontaneous late preterm delivery
Women with isolated oligohydramnios managed conservatively
cohort: 10,589 births, including women with isolated oligohydramnios at late preterm (34-36.6 weeks of gestation) and a control group with normal amniotic fluid
finding: Induction of labor in women with late preterm isolated oligohydramnios appears beneficial, resulting in lower cesarean section rates and reduced maternal and neonatal morbidity compared to conservative management.
mod_finding: Induction of labor in women with late preterm isolated oligohydramnios was associated with a reduced risk for cesarean section.
